components.summary: Adds the factory wire implementation directly to the dedicated source list that links GameServer decoder calls.

components.title: Peer observer ownership and lifecycle
components.summary: Maps authenticated dispatch through default-off preparation, one application, const before/after observation, and bounded private evidence recording.

flows.title: Authenticated factory packet to bounded peer record

steps.description: Prepare default-off, frame-windowed capture before applying the authenticated submission.
Apply the submission exactly once on the existing service path.
Read origin authority, replay classification, keyed result or fence, and full ring digest through the const observer.
Record the before and after observations without changing application control flow.
Emit schema barc.fr5.peer-observation/1 under the bounded owned sink.

facts.statement: The dedicated target source list now includes ExternalAI/FactoryReplacementWire.cpp, closing the source membership gap for GameServer's factory replacement decoder calls.
The observer is disabled without BARC_FR5_PEER_OBSERVER_ROOT and limits a process to 4,096 records and 16 MiB; its records use schema barc.fr5.peer-observation/1.
The authenticated handler surrounds exactly one ApplySubmission call with conditional observation, while the service observation path reads state without invoking a mutator.
The retained build6 log reports successful spring-dedicated and spring-headless links, engine version 1ec00cf, all four focused engine CTests passed, and all five HighBar adapter CTests passed.

Build and focused CTest success do not establish installation, publication, game execution, paired peer equality, callbacks, refunds, cleanup, useful play, or native admission; native game observations remain 0 of 6.

open_questions: Will six native game observations independently confirm the accepted source and build behavior?
